scope: Corollary 6.1 (Consequences of negative KEP) of the manuscript “An explicit obstruction to nuclear norm-ultrapower embeddings” (preprints/An-explicit-obstruction-to-nuclear-norm-ultrapower-embeddings-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 292 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d38fbd185d56ad4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Neither O2 nor any exact or nuclear unital C∗-algebra is existentially closed among unital C∗-algebra extensions. For every free ultrafilter ω on N, there are a separable unital C∗-algebra D and α ∈ Aut(D) such that D embeds unitally into Oω 2 but D ⋊α Z does not embed unitally there. Some satisfiable finite condition p(x) = {φj(x) < rj : 1 ≤ j ≤ s} in the unital C∗-algebra language, with x = (x1, . . . , xm), quantifier-free φj and rj > 0, lacks good nuclear witnesses: for some ε0 > 0, every realization a = (ai)m i=1 of p in every unital C∗-algebra E satisfies max1≤i≤m ∥ψϕ(ai) − ai∥ ≥ ε0 for every finite-dimensional C∗-algebra F and all completely positive contractive maps ϕ : E → F, ψ : F → E, not necessarily unital.
